scheme_name: West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme: Waiver of Fees for Land Conversion and Mutation
other_conditions: The unit should have started production on or after 1st April 2022.
Units may be in the private sector, co‑operative sector, joint sector or owned/managed by the State Government.
The project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank or State Financial Institution.
The unit must hold a Registration Certificate, Date of Commencement Certificate and Eligibility Certificate issued by the West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation Limited.
benefits_summary: 100% waiver of fees for land conversion and mutation for approved projects.
documents_required: Eligibility Certificate issued by West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation Limited
